learning_outcomes.text: Students can explain the concepts of vector calculus and apply them in practical examples.
They can differentiate and integrate functions and master the relationship between differentiation and integration.
Students can handle linear equation systems.
They also know some numerical solution methods.

syllabus_topics: Vector calculus in two and three dimensions
Differential calculus of one real variable
Integral calculus of one real variable
assessment_rules: The module is completed with a module examination. The module examination is a written exam of 120 minutes. Credit points are awarded if the module examination is passed.
bibliography: Burg, Klemens; Haf, Herbert; Wille, Friedrich: Höhere Mathematik für Ingenieure : Band I-III
